name: Refiner
summary: Customer-feedback / microsurvey platform (Refiner). It runs a first-party MCP server at app.refiner.io/v001/mcp: under the user's own Refiner OAuth login, a connected AI reads survey data through read-only tools (get-responses returns raw responses up to 500/page, contact data excluded; get-aggregated-response-data returns NPS/CSAT charts; plus list tools). A keyless initialize returned 401 Bearer on 2026-11-15. No tool turns open-text comments into themes, quotes or counts; the docs frame that as the connected model's act, so hr.summarize-engagement-feedback is empty.

payments.notes: refiner.io/pricing (200, 2026-11-15): a permanent free tier (all Essentials features, 25 responses/mo) includes MCP integrations, so the listed MCP surface is free; hence freemium. Paid plans checkout by card; annual Growth/Enterprise also invoice/bank-transfer. priceList points at the page.

agentAccess.notes: Not keyless. Fixed public endpoint https://app.refiner.io/v001/mcp; a keyless initialize returned 401 with WWW-Authenticate: Bearer realm="mcp" on 2026-11-15, bare GET 405 (Allow: POST). Metadata names app.refiner.io as the OAuth2 server, with four read scopes; sign-in is the user's Refiner login.
